UI_Talky_Toast_CommandCopied: Command for /hooks/%1 copied: run it in the Talky folder
UI_Talky_Toast_HookIdUnsafe: Rename /hooks/%1 first: letters, digits, - and _ only
UI_Talky_Toast_TestSent: Test of "%1" sent to the bridge
UI_Talky_Status_Online: Bridge connected on port %1 - %2 job(s) waiting
UI_Talky_Status_Offline: Bridge offline: run start-bridge.cmd (or node bridge/bridge.js) on this PC.
UI_Talky_Status_HookUrls: URL of each webhook, to paste in a LibertyTalk webhook call (the token is never shown)
UI_Talky_Status_UrlCommandHelp: Copy command: run it in a terminal in the Talky folder, the bridge copies the full URL.
UI_Talky_Status_Recent: Latest events received by the bridge
UI_Talky_Hooks_Intro: Each webhook is one /hooks/<id> URL. Create as many as you need and link each one to a workflow.
UI_Talky_Hooks_SelectLeft: Select a webhook on the left.
UI_Talky_Hooks_RoutesCount: %1 route(s): the first one whose condition matches wins.
UI_Talky_Hooks_TokenYes: Yes: this webhook takes its own token, not the bridge token.
UI_Talky_Hooks_TokenNo: No: this webhook takes the bridge token.
UI_Talky_Hooks_TokenUnknown: Unknown: start the bridge (0.4.0 or later).
UI_Talky_Hooks_TokenWhere: Set in bridge/config.json > hookTokens (the game cannot read it).
UI_Talky_Hooks_BodyHint: Suggested body on the LibertyTalk side:
UI_Talky_Wf_SelectLeft: Select or create a workflow on the left.
UI_Talky_Wf_Steps: Steps (run in order, double-click to edit)
UI_Talky_Wf_JsonHelp: The whole workflow: when, chance, cooldowns, steps
UI_Talky_Events_Intro: When something happens in the game, run a workflow (for example, post in the chat with an HTTP call).
UI_Talky_Set_maxActiveJobs: Max workflows running at the same time
UI_Talky_Settings_Shortcut: Opening key: Options > Keybinds > Talky (F8 by default).
UI_Talky_Settings_File: File: Zomboid/Lua/%1 (reloaded live by the bridge).
UI_Talky_Editor_AdvancedHelp: if / random / repeat / set / chance: see the README
UI_Talky_Editor_BridgeSide: Run by the bridge, not by the game.
UI_Talky_Editor_ActionJsonHelp: Free fields: any parameter of the action
UI_Talky_Act_emit: Send an event to the bridge
UI_Talky_Param_OnGround: On the ground instead of the inventory
UI_Talky_Bridge_TooOld: Bridge older than 0.4.0: game events and Test now need bridge 0.4.0. Update the bridge together with the mod.
UI_Talky_Skip_test_code_mismatch: test code mismatch, press Test now again
UI_Talky_Mode_Solo: Single player: the jobs run in this game.
UI_Talky_Server_Waiting: waiting for the answer of the server...
UI_Talky_Server_Allowed: the server runs your jobs (Talky %1 on the server).
UI_Talky_Server_NotAllowed: the server refuses the jobs of %1.
UI_Talky_Server_NotAllowedHelp: A server admin adds your username to Sandbox Options > Talky > Allowed players, or gives you the admin or moderator role.
UI_Talky_Server_NotAllowedHost: Your role on this server is not admin: click Allow me, or add %1 to Sandbox Options > Talky > Allowed players.
UI_Talky_Server_Version: Talky %1 on the server, %2 here: install the same version on both.
UI_Talky_Server_NoAnswer: no answer from the server. Look for [Talky] lines in the server console.
UI_Talky_Solo_NoAnswer: Single player: the Talky game code did not start. Look for [Talky] errors in console.txt (Zomboid folder).
UI_Talky_Server_Caps: Server limits: %1 zombies per action, %2 per job, spawn distance %3, %4 job(s) at a time.
UI_Talky_Server_JobsNoAnswer: %1 job(s) without answer from the server: sent again every 30 s.
UI_Talky_Toast_AllowMeSent: Admin role requested from the server
UI_Talky_Toast_JobRejected: Talky: job #%1 refused by the server (%2)
UI_Talky_Toast_JobTooLarge: Talky: job #%1 is too large to be sent to the server, skipped
UI_Talky_Reason_disabled: action turned off on the server
UI_Talky_Settings_ServerNote: Multiplayer: the limits below come from the server (Sandbox Options > Talky).
